clues.it: Marta era nella 5ª colonna e nella 1ª riga.
clues.en: Marta was in the 5th column and in the 1st row.

clues.it: Bruno era nella 1ª colonna e a nord di Sergio.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 1st column and north of Sergio.

clues.it: Giada era l'unica seduta su uno sgabello.
clues.en: Giada was the only one sitting on a stool.
Olga was on a bed of straw.

clues.it: Elena era accanto a un calderone e a una libreria.
clues.en: Elena was beside a cauldron and a bookcase.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 6ª riga e accanto a un'armatura.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 6th row and beside a suit of armor.
Carla was beside a suit of armor.

clues.it: Sergio era nella Torre del Mago.
clues.en: Sergio was in the Wizard Tower.

clues.it: Rosa era accanto a una runa.
clues.en: Rosa was beside a glowing rune.

clues.it: Anna era nella 4ª colonna e su della paglia.
clues.en: Anna was in the 4th column and on a bed of straw.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

steps.it: L'indizio di Marta lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Marta's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 5th.

steps.it: Solo Bruno può stare nella 2ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 1ª è sua.
steps.en: Bruno is the only one who can be in the 2nd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 1st is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Elena più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 5ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Elena's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 5th, column 3rd.
